title: Naturally Smoky Roasted German Beef Roast
description: A rich, velvety German dish featuring a beef roast, smoky from the cedar plank. Perfect for a weeknight dinner with a hint of mixed spice.

ingredients.name: 6 pound beef roast (such as top round or rump roast)
1 cup mixed spice blend (containing caraway seeds, coriander, and nutmeg)
Cedar plank (large enough for the roast)

instructions: Preheat oven to 300°F (150°C).
Rinse the beef roast and pat it dry with paper towels.
Season the roast with salt and pepper.
Mix the spice blend, thyme, and rosemary together in a small bowl and rub the mixture all over the roast, making sure to coat it evenly.
Place the garlic, beef broth, vinegar, brown sugar, and water in a small saucepan and bring to a simmer over medium heat.
Reduce the sauce to a glaze and let it cool to room temperature.
Place a cedar plank on a baking sheet and pour the glaze over it, spreading it evenly with a spatula.
Place the roast on the plank and brush the top with olive oil.
Put the baking sheet in the oven and roast for 2 1/2 hours, or until the roast reaches an internal temperature of 135°F (57°C).
Remove the roast from the oven and let it rest for 10 minutes before slicing and serving.
Garnish with chopped parsley and serve with boiled potatoes and steamed vegetables, if desired.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
Garnish with additional parsley before serving, if desired.
Sliced and served with a side of sauerkraut for a classic German twist.
Leftovers can be refrigerated for up to 3 days and reheated in a low oven or on the stovetop, covered with a lid.
Reheat with additional broth if the roast becomes dry during reheating.
Serve with a side salad or steamed vegetables for a balanced meal.
Serve with a side of braised red cabbage for a hearty winter meal.
If desired, serve with a side of egg noodles for a comforting German-inspired dish.
Reheat with additional broth if the roast becomes dry during reheating, and serve with a side of steamed vegetables for a fresh take on a classic meal.
